name: FEARS + LAURA OLIM
description: FEARS and Laura Olim perform a concert at Radioclube Agramonte in Porto. The event is scheduled for November 6, 2026, starting at 10 PM.
longDescription:
FEARS and Laura Olim are set to perform a concert at Radioclube Agramonte in Porto. The event takes place on November 6, 2026, with a start time of 10 PM.

The concert has a duration of 60 minutes and is promoted by Radioclube Agramonte. Tickets are priced at 10€, and the event is open to individuals aged 16 and over.

Radioclube Agramonte is located at Rua João Martins Branco 180, 4150-430 Porto.
